B. Characterization of deposited CeO2 films
The structural properties of the as-deposited CeO2 films were analyzed by x-ray diffraction (XRD) θ–2θ scans... The surface morphology was determined by atomic force microscopy (AFM, Bruker Dimension Icon in tapping mode). Film thicknesses were measured by x-ray fluorescence spectroscopy (XRF, Rigaku 3630 WD-XRF)... The film composition and chemical state at discrete film depths were analyzed by x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, Thermo Scientific)... To understand the reaction mechanism taking place during the ALD process of Ce(iPrCp)2(iPr-amd) and water, QMS was used for the in situ analysis of the gases present in the reactor.
